thag10.4:1.1: Dandhā mayhaṃ gatī āsi, paribhūto pure ahaṃ, bhātā ca maṃ paṇāmesi: gaccha dāni tuvaṃ gharaṃ. || ||
thag10.4:2.1: so 'haṃ paṇāmito santo saṃghārāmassa koṭṭhake dummano tattha aṭṭhāsiṃ sāsanasmiṃ apekkhavā. || ||
thag10.4:3.1: bhagavā tattha āgacchi, sīsaṃ mayhaṃ parāmasi, bāhāya maṃ gahetvāna saṃghārāmaṃ pavesayi. || ||
thag10.4:4.1: anukampāya me satthā pādāsi pādapuñchaniṃ: etaṃ suddhaṃ adhiṭṭhehi ekamantaṃ svadhiṭṭhitaṃ. || ||
thag10.4:5.1: tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā vihāsiṃ sāsane rato, samādhiṃ paṭipādesiṃ uttamatthassa pattiyā. || ||
thag10.4:6.1: pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thag10.4:7.1: sahassakkhattum attānaṃ nimminitvāna Panthako nisīdi ambavane ramme yāva kālappavedanaṃ. || ||
thag10.4:8.1: tato me satthā pāhesi dūtaṃ kālappavedakaṃ; paveditamhi kālamhi vehāsān upasaṃkamiṃ. || ||
thag10.4:9.1: vanditvā satthuno pāde ekamantaṃ nisīd' ahaṃ; nisinnaṃ maṃ viditvāna atha satthā paṭiggahi. || ||
thag10.4:10.1: āyāgo sabbalokassa āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho puññakhettaṃ manussānaṃ paṭigaṇhittha dakkhiṇan ti. || || Cūḷapanthako thero.
